posts.text: Software engineering is not just about writing code. It's about understanding problems, understanding users, and building the right solution.

A New Chapter Begins at Cozentus!

I’m excited to share that I’ve started a new chapter in my professional journey with Cozentus, joining on 9th September 2026 as an Officer – Python Developer.

A Beautiful Chapter Comes to an End.

On 5th September, I completed a beautiful and unforgettable journey with HIREKARMA. What started as a professional opportunity turned into a journey filled with learning, growth, challenges, achievements, and meaningful relationships.

I’m truly grateful for the incredible exposure and learning opportunities I received along the way. Beyond the professional experience, the personal bonds and friendships I built here will always hold a special place in my heart.

A special thank you to Sohan Kumar Dey and Rohit Samantaray for believing in me and giving me the opportunity to be a part of this journey.

We're Hiring: Full Stack Developer

We're looking for a passionate Full Stack Developer with experience in FastAPI (Python), Next.js, PostgreSQL, Alembic, AWS, Docker, and AI-powered development tools.

Half of 2026 is already behind us, and it has been one of the most rewarding learning phases of my software engineering journey.

In the first six months of the year, I crossed 2,370 GitHub contributions, with 1,400+ contributions in Q2 alone.

Excited to share a small milestone in my GitHub journey!

I’m proud to have been ranked in the Top 50% percentile (B+) of GitHub users worldwide based on my contribution activity and developer metrics.
